reasoning: Identity, text and inventory are correct: the held 42 FR 4325 text has two sections, both amending EO 10900, and both are inventoried with exact quotes. The legal analysis is sound in substance: EO 12148 revoked only section 4(d)(2) and EO 12163 added a subsection to section 3, so neither ended the added section 1(d) or touched the revoked section 5; EO 12220 section 1-501 revoked EO 10900 as amended with no deferred effective date or saving clause, the OFR catalog note on EO 11963 records 'Revoked by: EO 12220, June 27, 1980', and the U.S. Code 7 U.S.C. 1691 note agrees; the reissued reporting direction in EO 12220 is a separate command. But every first_end.date and the whole_order_end.date read 1977-06-27, which is not the date of the cited ending instrument (June 27, 1980) and contradicts the claim's own judgment_reason and research_rationale. A wrong end date in the dated fields is disqualifying even though the prose gives the right date. Corrected to 1980-06-27 in all three fields, the claim would appear supportable on the held sources.
